title: Deep anterior lamellar keratoplasty versus penetrating keratoplasty: comparison of clinical outcomes in contralateral eyes

license.statement: Creative Commons Attribution License, version not stated (article <license>)

indication: Contralateral eyes of 26 patients (keratoconus 19, stromal dystrophy 6, post-LASIK ectasia 1): PK in the eye with Descemet membrane rupture (hydrops history, opacities) or deep dystrophic lesions, big-bubble DALK in the fellow eye; one surgeon; eye-bank donor corneas in Eusol-C; minimum follow-up 3 years

groups.description: Deep anterior lamellar keratoplasty (big bubble) eyes, contralateral to the PK eyes; host Descemet membrane and endothelium retained

series.baseline_label: Table 2 'Preoperative' ECD of the PK group; Methods describe donor ECD measured by the eye bank (Konan EKA-04); recorded as the donor eye-bank reference (uncertain, see record notes)
series.notes: Table 2 PK row, mean ± SD at preoperative, 6, 12, 24 and 36 months; postoperative ECD by Topcon SP-2000P; no per-visit n

series.baseline_label: Table 2 'Preoperative' ECD of the DALK group, recorded as the host preoperative ECD (DALK retains the host endothelium; uncertain, see record notes)
series.notes: Table 2 DALK row, mean ± SD at preoperative, 6, 12, 24 and 36 months; postoperative ECD by Topcon SP-2000P; no per-visit n

exclusions.reason: percent loss of the same groups; the absolute ECD series is used (cells also use decimal commas)

notes: Reference ambiguity: Table 2 labels the reference column 'Preoperative' for both groups. Methods state that donor ECD was measured with the eye bank's Konan EKA-04 and postoperative ECD with a Topcon SP-2000P, but do not state how the preoperative value of each group was obtained. Following the protocol definitions, the PK reference is recorded as donor eye-bank ECD and the DALK reference as the host's preoperative ECD; both reference kinds are uncertain.
Two standard keratoplasty techniques compared in contralateral operated eyes without an investigational agent; both recorded as control with per-group procedure (pk, dalk).
Microperforation occurred in 4 DALK eyes without conversion to PK (Abstract).
